OPTIONAL SPECIALIST BRANCH / SIGNAL OPERATIONS

Keep the network alive.

Matrix of Conscience trains more than tower placement. In Signal Operations, learn to read systems, control a hostile process, and protect the Core through terminal-inspired challenges.

Your VIM/Bash and PowerShell progress remains local and separate from the main Act I–IV mission score, while the LMS can recognize the earned specialist milestone.

HOME ROW / BASH ACADEMY

VIM Defense

Move with H J K L, fire with Space, deploy drones, and answer Bash questions between waves. Mobile players can slide across the H / FIRE / L / DRONE control strip.

Enter VIM / Bash Defense →

COMMAND LINE / PIPELINE TACTICS

PowerShell Defense

Build a defensive pipeline, learn filtering and objects, and face a quiz-shielded Rogue Script AI. Commands are displayed as educational text and never executed.

Enter PowerShell Defense →

How this fits Matrix

Acts I–IV remain the flagship tower-defense campaign. Signal Operations is the specialist branch: a replayable way to practice control, debugging, and adaptive defense without replacing earlier saves or moral decisions.
